تمتنعن (form VIII)
# تَمْتَنِعْنَ (tamtaniʕna) /tam.ta.niʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# تُمْتَنَعْنَ (tumtanaʕna) /tum.ta.naʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
